page_title: BookedCall QA for Home Service Shops
meta_description: Weekly call-scoring and coaching briefs that help home service companies convert more inbound calls into booked jobs.
for_whom: For home service companies with recorded inbound calls
hero_headline: Turn more inbound calls into booked jobs
hero_subheadline: BookedCall QA reviews your recorded calls each week, scores the missed revenue moments, and sends a simple coaching brief your team can act on fast.
credibility_line: Least-privilege access. No-shame coaching. Fixed weekly review scope.
pain_paragraph: You already pay for calls through SEO, ads, and referrals. The leak happens after the phone rings: missed asks for the appointment, weak handling of price objections, sloppy dispatch questions, or no clear next step. Most owners never see the pattern because they don't have time to listen to recordings at scale.
before: You only hear the disaster calls, not the 20 almost-booked ones
Front-desk coaching is random and based on anecdotes
Ad spend gets blamed when the real problem is call handling
Nobody can say why calls didn't convert by rep or objection type
after: A weekly scorecard on a fixed batch of calls
Tagged missed-booking reasons and objection patterns
3-5 concrete coaching actions for the next week
A repeatable benchmark by rep, source, and call outcome
offer_summary: A done-for-you weekly call QA desk for one location: we review a fixed batch of inbound recordings, score them against a booking rubric, and send you a coaching brief with the exact leaks to fix next.
included: Review up to 40 inbound calls per week on the starter plan
Call scoring rubric tuned for booking quality, not just politeness
Missed-booking reason tags (price objection, no ask, bad fit triage, slow follow-up, etc.)
Weekly owner brief with 3-5 coaching priorities
2-3 rewritten talk tracks or call snippets for training
30-day rolling benchmark so you can see if booking quality improves
excluded: Live call answering or receptionist services
Full call center training programs or in-person coaching
Support for shops without recording access or enough inbound volume
process: Fit call: confirm niche, call volume, and recording access
Week 1 setup: finalize rubric, outcomes taxonomy, and report format
Weekly review: score the agreed batch of calls and tag missed-booking reasons
Delivery: owner coaching brief + rep-level examples + next-step talk tracks
Iteration: refine rubric as patterns emerge and compare week-over-week results
pricing_details: Starter includes up to 40 scored calls per week for one location. Growth tier starts at $1,499/mo for higher volume, multiple reps, or multi-location rollups. Pilot audit: $199 for one scored-call batch + coaching brief.
guarantee_line: If the first pilot audit doesn't surface clear missed-booking patterns you can act on, we won't continue to retainer.

faq.q: How do you access recordings safely?
faq.a: Least-privilege access only. We work from recorded-call exports or shared call-tracking access, not your broader systems. We can work under NDA and follow a defined deletion window.

faq.q: What do you need before onboarding?
faq.a: You need recorded inbound calls, enough weekly call volume to score a meaningful sample, and one owner/manager who can act on the weekly coaching brief.
Only if you use it badly. The framing is no-shame coaching: patterns, examples, and scripts-not public blame. We focus on process gaps and repeatable fixes.
Usually under a week. We confirm access, define the scoring rubric, align on outcomes, and then the first scored batch goes out in the next weekly cycle.

faq.q: How long do you keep our recordings and notes?
faq.a: Only as long as needed for the active engagement and benchmark window you approve. We can set a fixed retention period and delete raw files on request.

trust_basics_line: You keep control of coaching and staffing decisions. We provide the scoring workflow, examples, and weekly brief-not HR decisions or legal advice.
